versions.content: The RSA public key in the format CRYPTO_KE_FORMAT_BIN _RSA_PUBLICKEY is provided as follows: RSAPublicKey ::= SEQUENCE { modulus INTEGER, -- n publicExponent INTEGER, -- e } The fields of type RSAPublicKey have the following meanings:  modulus is the modulus n.  publicExponent is the public exponent e.
